Invalid/unfinished critique or exhausted budget gives `needs_review`/failed analysis, never auto-approval; failed caption critique requires recorded human resolution or a new bounded authorized revision, not an eighth hidden call. A subsequent user-requested revision is a new bounded authorization. Resuming after human review reloads the pinned job ledger and validates unexpired authorization; expired reservations require a new estimate, never unrestricted continuation. The 20-round review requested for these documents is NOT a requirement to run 20 paid model calls for each episode.
